title: Achieve AWS Solutions Architect Certification
description: Pass the AWS SAA-C03 exam and apply cloud architecture best practices to current projects.

title: Master GraphQL
description: Complete advanced GraphQL course, implement subscriptions, and migrate one service.

title: Give a Tech Talk
description: Present a 30-minute tech talk on microservices patterns at the monthly engineering all-hands.

title: Learn Kubernetes
description: Set up a production-ready K8s cluster, deploy three microservices, configure auto-scaling.

title: Become Team Lead
description: Demonstrate leadership by leading sprint planning, mentoring a junior, and improving team velocity by 15%.

title: Read 12 Technical Books
description: Read one technical book per month to broaden knowledge in architecture, algorithms, and leadership.

title: Complete Java Spring Certification
description: Pass the Spring Professional certification exam and apply knowledge in the notification service project.

title: Improve Code Review Skills
description: Conduct at least 50 code reviews, focusing on security, performance, and maintainability.

title: Launch Open-Source Project
description: Create and launch a Vue.js component library on GitHub and npm with at least 100 stars.

title: Mentor a New Hire
description: Volunteer to onboard and mentor an incoming junior engineer for their first 3 months.
